Solarflower Floriography: Warmth, unity, optimism, and yearning for a bright future. Backstory: Even when it is in a dim environment, it will grow toward the direction of the sun. Recipients: Suitable for most people, the first choice for official and business occasions. Rainbow Floriography: Simple beauty and living in the moment. Recipients: Cheap and suitable for everyone.
